templates.text: Turn in 3 quests with a guildie nearby in your group.
Make {X} something, like gear, a bag, food or bandages, and trade it to them. Then quest or do a dungeon for 10 minutes with them in your group.
Catch fish, mine, pick herbs or skin 10 times in all, with a guildie nearby in your group.
Run a dungeon with {X}, a guildie close to your level.
{X} is active, and you haven't grouped this week. Quest for 10 minutes with them in your group.
Help {X}, a guildie at least 5 levels below you: quest or do a dungeon for 10 minutes with them in your group.
Turn in a quest marked Elite or Group with at least 2 guildies nearby in your group.
Run a dungeon with at least 2 other guildies.
Quest or do a dungeon for 10 minutes with a new member in your group.
Quest or do dungeons with 3 different guildies this week, 10 minutes with each in your group.
Group with a guildie for 10 minutes on 3 different days this week.
Run a dungeon with a full party of guildies.
